packs.title: Korean Basics 1: Core Grammar Foundations
packs.description: Build a strong foundation in Korean by learning essential grammar patterns like "to be," present tense, location particles, sentence connectors, and basic expressions. This unit will help you form simple, natural sentences with confidence.

packs.title: Korean Basics 2: Expanding Expression
packs.description: Take your Korean to the next level by learning how to express wants, future plans, reasons, contrasts, and polite commands. This unit helps you build more natural and flexible sentences for everyday conversations.
